Question 1
?
Consider the following relation defined on the set A={−1,2,6,9}.

R={(−1,−1),(2,2),(2,6),(6,6)} Select the options that make the following reasoning correct:

Since
 
(x,x)∉R
(x,x)∈R
(9,9)∉R
(6,6)∉R
 
and (2,6)∈R
for all x∈A
and (6,6)∈R
and (6,2)∉R
,

the relation is
 
reflexive
irreflexive
both reflexive and irreflexive
neither reflexive nor irreflexive
.
Submit
